about: Vaibhav Vyapaar Limited is an RBI-registered NBFC based in Kolkata that gives unsecured personal loans to salaried and self-employed individuals through its digital LoanFront mobile app, both on its own books and via co-lending with other NBFCs. It also earns revenue from technology services to other NBFCs. AUM was Rs 81.24 crore at 31 Jul 2026 (Rs 70.68 crore at Mar-26), with the top five states (Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, Telangana, Andhra Pradesh, Maharashtra) at 77.09% of AUM.

objects.purpose: Augment the capital base of the company (Tier I capital for onward lending)
General corporate purposes (capped at 15% of gross proceeds or Rs 10 crore, whichever is less)

promoters.background: Capfront Technologies (holding company, acquired the NBFC in Oct 2019) holds 99.98%; Itha Venkata Raghava Gowrinath is Chairman and Managing Director.

concentration.note: Top five states were 77.09% of AUM at 31 Jul 2026 (Tamil Nadu 22.49%, Karnataka 14.68%, Telangana 14.31%, Andhra Pradesh 13.41%, Maharashtra 11.54%).

litigation_note: No cases against the company or promoters; one tax proceeding against a director (non-promoter) of Rs 0.78 lakh.
strengths: Fully digital lending app LoanFront with in-house technology, paperless onboarding and underwriting.
AUM grew 48.95% in FY26 to Rs 70.68 crore; revenue grew 46.91% to Rs 36.80 crore.
Strong capital position: CRAR 43.80% at Jul-26 against the 15% RBI minimum.
Interest rate spread steady at about 12.6% to 13.3% over three years.
Gross NPA improved from 6.72% (FY24) to 4.71% (FY26); about 75% to 80% of revenue comes from repeat customers.
EBITDA margin rose from 21.31% in FY24 to 29.47% in FY26 and PAT has grown every year.
Diversified lending model mixing direct lending and co-lending, with presence across 25 states and UTs.
Experienced management team and NBFC licence held since 2010.

risks.title: Negative operating cash flow
risks.detail: Operating cash flow was negative Rs 4.34 crore in FY24 and negative Rs 18.44 crore in FY26 as the loan book grew; only FY25 (Rs 0.31 crore) was positive.

risks.title: Heavy dependence on unsecured loans
risks.detail: The whole AUM is unsecured personal loans to higher-risk borrowers; gross NPA was 4.71% and net NPA 2.94% in FY26 (net NPA up from 0.60% in FY24).

risks.title: Rising leverage
risks.detail: Borrowings rose to Rs 46.80 crore in FY26 from Rs 22.66 crore in FY25; debt/equity went from 0.83 to 1.60, with about Rs 39.75 crore of it short-term.

risks.title: Related-party dealings with holding company
risks.detail: Management fee to holding Capfront was Rs 5.34 crore in FY26 (14.51% of revenue); claims receivable from it were Rs 3.08 crore and service fees payable Rs 1.27 crore at Jul-26.

risks.title: Promoter control and dependence on holding company
risks.detail: Promoters will hold about 72.34% post-issue. The company relies on the holding company's permission to use its domain name and does not own it.

risks.title: Small scale and thin profits
risks.detail: FY26 PAT was only Rs 1.97 crore (5.36% margin) on revenue of Rs 36.80 crore; RoE was 6.99%. Finance costs consumed Rs 6.64 crore.

risks.title: Geographic concentration
risks.detail: Top five states account for 77.09% of AUM at Jul-26; Tamil Nadu alone is 22.49%. Regional shocks could hit asset quality.

risks.title: Compliance and governance gaps
risks.detail: Restated financials were prepared by a peer-reviewed CA who is not the statutory auditor; stamp duty was unpaid on a business transfer agreement with the holding company; NCD compliances were delayed; no monitoring agency for issue proceeds.

notes: Standalone restated figures (NBFC, lakhs converted to Rs crore). Jul-2026 stub period (4 months) ignored in arrays: revenue Rs 18.00 crore, PAT Rs 3.01 crore, net worth Rs 47.20 crore, CRAR 43.80%. EBITDA as reported in RHP (PBT + depreciation + finance cost - other income). Operating cash flow reconciled to RHP risk table (-434.15, 30.52, -1843.74 lakh). Borrowings = long-term + short-term. Reservation percentages are of the net issue of 74,06,000 shares (anchor is a subset of QIB; market maker portion of 3,90,000 shares excluded). Price band, issue size in Rs and P/E are blank in the RHP. Current ratio not reported (NBFC). Moneyview NAV omitted due to inconsistent table values.
